result.title: Sharp Covering-Number Bounds for Feedforward ReLU Networks via Parameter Symmetries
result.summary: In neural networks, distinct parameter configurations often realize the same input--output mapping, indicating that nominal parameter counts can overstate functional complexity. In this paper, we characterize the parameter-space symmetries of ReLU and Leaky ReLU networks across fully connected, convolutional, and residual architectures. We prove that every quasianalytic parameter map preserving the network function is a composition of positive channel scaling and channel permutation. By quotienting out both symmetries, we derive uniform covering-number upper bounds in which positive scaling reduces the complexity exponent from the total parameter count $S$ to $S-H$ (with $H$ denoting the number of scalable channels) and permutation symmetry divides the bound by the factorial count $G$ of channel permutations. We establish matching lower bounds showing that the exponent $S-H$ is sharp in general and that the divisor $G$ is attained for one-hidden-layer and generically identifiable networks. We further extend these results to general continuous piecewise-linear activated networks. Finally, we apply our covering-number bounds to derive statistical risk guarantees for empirical risk minimization and capacity control beyond i.i.d.\ settings, and show how the underlying symmetries help explain weight rebalancing in function approximation and flat directions in empirical risk optimization.

AI.brief_summary: 论文刻画全连接、卷积与残差 ReLU/Leaky ReLU 网络的参数空间对称性，证明保函数的拟解析参数映射仅为正通道缩放与通道置换的复合，并通过商掉这两类对称性给出覆盖数上界与匹配下界，再据此推导经验风险最小化的统计风险保证。
AI.relevance_reason: 正通道缩放与通道置换造成的函数等价意味着隐状态在数值尺度与通道顺序上不可辨识，可能为跨层、跨模型的 latent 相似度比较与表示几何分析提供归一化与容量视角，可供核查。
